text: Why NANCHANG HANGKONG UNIVERSIY?1.Situated in NANCHANG HANGKONG, a key modern city in the east area of China;2.Engineering oriented comprehensive university; one of the best universities that has the major of civil engineering in China;3.Pure English taught programs;4.Accommodation for international students equippedwith complete facilities;5.Good climate with mild four seasons;6.Convenient shopping environment.Teaching Objective:Cultivate professional talents with solid theoretical basis and strong practical ability, able to engage in project planning, design, R&D and management of civil engineering. Mainly learn the knowledge in the aspects of mechanics, civil engineering planning and model selection, engineering materials, foundation treatment, project management, and etc., and master basic skills in construction technology, engineering surveying, experiment and comprehensive application of computer and modern equipment for project design, construction and management.Curriculum:The undergraduate courses mainly include Theoretical Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, Structural Mechanics, Architecture for Buildings, Soil Mechanics and Science,Foundation Engineering, Reinforced-concrete Structures,Steel Structures, Civil Engineering Construction, Bridge Engineering, Road Engineering,etc.
